results_seen_note: Filed after the s4b forecast run finished and before 03_evaluate.py was run; no 4b output had been opened. Decision logged in DEVIATIONS.md during the run.

changes.part_b_surges.secondary_surges: two secondary surge definitions for Part B, each with its own classifiers and average precision, reported beside the primary log(1.3) surge and never instead of it: (1) base-rate surge = 2-month change in log share at or above the 98th percentile of that change within the same format and level, the percentile computed on the training rows of each origin only; (2) 20% surge = 2-month change >= log(1.2). Same models, features, horizons, bootstrap and helps rule as the primary surge.

reason: Parameter audit (P44): the 30% surge had no written rationale and a base rate of 0.7% to 1.4% of rows, which makes average precision unstable.
